data.summary_en: We propose ClawLoop, with no external teacher model, forming a self-improvement loop of task synthesis, training, and diagnostic feedback. Qwen3.6-27B as the loop model achieves consistent gains on SkillsBench, Claw-Eval-Live, and ClawGym-Bench; iterated tasks transferred to Qwen3.5-4B and 9B also improve all benchmarks.
